summary: Verified HRMS simplified Attendance->Payroll workflow (Iter 81). Backend 11/11 pytest pass covering: GET /payroll/attendance-lock (empty + populated), finalize-attendance role gate (accountant 403), finalize-attendance blocks on unmarked attendance (400), 423 enforcement on POST /attendance and PATCH /attendance/{aid} when a center+month lock exists, /attendance/unlock clears the lock and PATCH succeeds afterwards, unlock role gate (accountant 403), and legacy /payroll/run and /payroll/finalise endpoints still mounted (regression). Frontend: HRMS Payroll tab renders new simplified UI as admin -- data-testid='finalize-attendance' present (admin/HR only), data-testid='payroll-quick-chips' present with exactly the 5 new status labels (All, HR Review, Approval Pending, Ready for Payment, Paid); no old 'Draft/Awaiting Accounts/Issue/Resolve' labels appear in the filter chips or status Select items (status values are internal; the label in the HR Review select item is 'HR Review'). Attendance Issues shown as a dedicated KPI counter (not as a status). Row-level testids (status-pill-<id>, review-attendance-<id>, process-payment-<id>) and attendance-locked-banner could not be observed because the test tenant currently has 0 payroll rows for Oct 2026 (no rows -> no row-level pills/banners rendered). The Finalize-Attendance confirm uses window.confirm (native browser dialog with the correct 'After finalization, attendance will be LOCKED' copy -- grep-verified in HRMS.jsx:928-933) rather than a Shadcn Dialog; both satisfy the spec but a styled modal would be more consistent with the rest of the app. Attendance-lock seeding/teardown via Mongo cleaned up after tests.

issues: 'Finalize Attendance' and 'Reopen Attendance' use window.confirm()/window.prompt() -- works, but inconsistent with the Shadcn AlertDialog UX used elsewhere in the app. Consider swapping to a styled modal for better accessibility, cancel button layout and consistent branding.
Pre-existing Recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on dashboard mount -- cosmetic, unrelated to this iteration.

action_items: (Optional UX) Replace window.confirm/prompt in finalizeAttendance/reopenAttendance with a Shadcn AlertDialog carrying the same copy (so the confirm dialog has data-testid, Cancel/Finalize buttons and can be theme-tested).

(Verification only) Row-level testids (status-pill-<id>, review-attendance-<id>, process-payment-<id>, attendance-locked-banner) are implemented in code but could not be visually asserted because the chosen tenant+month had zero draft rows. Main agent can self-verify by picking a center+month that has existing payroll rows (e.g. earlier batches on this cluster) or by generating via Refresh in a center with staff + attendance.
critical_code_review_comments: finalize_attendance (server.py L11921) calls payroll_run and then checks draft rows globally with status in [None, draft, reopened] -- if no center_id is specified, the scope filter is enforced via _in_scope using staff.center_id. Staff rows without center_id are silently excluded from scope; a comment in-code already warns about this. Behavior is correct but easy to miss.

_assert_attendance_editable depends on staff.center_id. For staff rows that have been assigned a center AFTER historical attendance was recorded, the lock will retroactively block historical edits -- expected and documented.
window.confirm+window.prompt is unidiomatic in a React/Shadcn app. Migrate to AlertDialog + Input modal to allow data-testid-based automated UI tests of the dialog copy.

No API-level test fixture seeds a *clean* month for happy-path finalize (needs POST /attendance for every staff for every working day). This is a legitimate gap for E2E regression but was called out as too heavy for this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: verified: all top-level testids & UI relabel present; row-level testids visually unverifiable due to zero rows (code-reviewed OK)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_attendance_finalize_lock.py is the baseline for the simplified Attendance->Payroll workflow. To E2E test the HAPPY path (clean month -> auto batch -> Approval Pending), pick a tenant/center that already has draft payroll rows for a given month and attendance 100% marked for its staff, then click Finalize Attendance -- UI should go to 'Attendance Finalized & Locked' banner and status pill 🟠 Approval Pending (or 🟣 Ready for Payment if no chain). Reopen via data-testid='reopen-attendance-banner' or 'reopen-attendance'. Clean up db.attendance_locks docs created during manual testing.
rca of the issue: N/A -- no functional issues found. The only UX nit is native window.confirm/prompt where a Shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent.
